title: Create a Space sends its main heading twice in the raw HTML and is the only marketing page that is never cached

source.ref: SCAN-1032 production header sweep, 2026-11-16 (fetched through the Vercel connector; no JavaScript run).

detail:
MEASURED 2026-11-16 on production: /create-a-space answers x-vercel-cache MISS with cache-control private, no-store on every fetch (the page declares force-dynamic), where the other 14 marketing pages in the audit list are prerendered and edge cached. Its h1 text also appears twice in the server HTML: once in the Suspense fallback and once in the streamed segment. WHY IT MATTERS: every visit to the main sign-up door pays a server render, and a crawler that does not run JavaScript reads two main headings. NOT YET KNOWN: whether the page must be dynamic (it redirects existing Space owners and starts the 12-minute timer for some entrants, both owner rulings of 2026-11-12), so caching it needs an owner ruling, not a blind fix. FIX DIRECTION: give the fallback a non-heading placeholder so one h1 is sent; then decide whether the per-visitor parts can move behind a client or Suspense boundary so the shell can be cached. FIXED 2026-11-16 (half 1): the Suspense fallback now renders the hero heading as a paragraph with no id (Island shell prop in components/frequency/site/pages/create-space/create-space-studio.tsx), so the server HTML carries one h1 and one #cs-h1; components/frequency/site/pages/create-space/create-space-studio.shell.test.tsx fails on the old code and passes on the new. STILL OPEN: the caching question waits on an owner ruling.

CLOSED 2026-11-16. Half 1 is live in production (one h1). Half 2: Daniel ruled on 2026-11-16 to keep /create-a-space uncached for launch, because the owner redirect and the 12-minute timer (rulings of 2026-11-12) read the visitor on the server. Revisit after launch only if its server render shows up as a cost.

verify.evidence: Passed 2026-11-16 on production dpl_85D5u8EzaZXFeqByBKSgipHH5R5j (f7481d9, carries #5091): the raw HTML of /create-a-space has one
